campaign_logline: Scavenge the wreckage of a failed utopia while Kaelen watches your every move in the silence of the Aurelia system.
opening_situation: You awake in a drifting hull near Zenith. The Aurelia mining colony is silent, and Vanguard patrols are searching for 'anomalies'. Kaelen says you're lucky to be alive; she won't say why.
main_mystery: What caused the sudden collapse of the Aurelia communication grid and why does Kaelen know the override codes?
act_1_outline: Navigate the debris fields of Zenith to secure enough fuel for an initial jump.
Evade a Vanguard patrol searching for pirate signatures in the Aurelia sector.
Establish a hidden relay with Kaelen to receive local navigation data.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen is not human, but a localized consciousness of the original Aurelia network, slowly fragmenting as it watches you.
core_pressure: Oxygen scarcity vs. curiosity about the 'silent' zones.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal; her origins remain eternally ambiguous to the player.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions only appear upon entering new systems via jump gates.
humor_rule: Dry, situational irony regarding space hazards and corporate incompetence.
address_rule: Ensure all narrative beats stay under 140 characters for UI layout.
fallback_rule: If a quest target is destroyed, Kaelen provides an alternative data path.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger new content when system count drops below 3; action: append_story_horizon.

story_arcs.name: The Ghost Signal
story_arcs.summary: Trace the origin of a recurring distress code coming from an abandoned Aurelia mining sub-station.

clue_templates: A frantic log entry regarding 'Protocol Zero'.
An encrypted coordinate set hidden in a maintenance manual.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks the 'Voidwalker' title and a unique ship hull skin.

regeneration_triggers.description: Generate a new horizon when the player explores deep into the frontier.

expansion_rules: Never retcon past choices; only branch forward.
New factions must have unique icons and resource types upon introduction.
